title: Session as Python
description: A Python script that replays the session's steps.

body.python_script:
from notte_sdk import NotteClient

client = NotteClient()

with client.Session() as session:
    session.execute(type="goto", url="https://example.com/shop")
    session.execute(type="fill", id="I1", value="ceramic mug")
    session.execute(type="click", id="B1")
    print(session.scrape())
